Aisha: Heads-up: shifting start by 7 minutes to let ops finish a hotfix for the recorder. New start 16:07 PT.
Jon: 7 mins ok. What's the hotfix?
Aisha: Recorder was dropping segments when slides change rapidly. Ops patched a debounce on slide-change events.
Priya: Could we also do a dual-record (local + S3) for tonight? If live fails we still want the master file.
Evan: We can enable dual-record for the session. DeployBot just deployed the switch to the all-hands group.
DeployBot: deploy: recorder-config updated: dual_record=true in cluster all-hands. OK (3.4s)
Nina: Reminder: presenters with video + desktop demos, please join the prep room 12m before start so we can wire inputs.
Aisha: +1. We'll circulate the prep-room link and time slots. If your demo uses USB audio, tell Ops in this thread so we map the device.
Jon: For the agenda, can we add a short live Q&A after Leadership? 8 minutes? Last time we ran out.
Aisha: Yes, adding an 8-min Q&A after leadership updates. If more, we'll collect follow-ups and answer asynchronously.
Priya: Recording note: leadership, please mute your mic until you speak and avoid system audio sharing; it duplicates channels for the recorder. Use the "Deck audio" input if you need slides audio.
Evan: If the stream starts buffering, try a soft-restart on the recorder container instead of full reboot: `kubectl exec -n recorder -c recorder pod/recorder-0 -- supervisorctl restart recorder` 
Aisha: OpsBot, can you run a quick health check now and post results?
OpsBot: health-check: recorder-0 CPU 18%, mem 52%, disk 62%, segment-latency 45ms. No alerts.
Nina: I'll standby for device mapping.
Jon: Quick mic-check for presenters: say "redwood live test" when you join.
Aisha: Thanks everyone. If leadership wants to pre-read any Qs, drop them here and I'll surface during the session. See you soon :raised_hands:
